ctx.x: his Harlemites. And the band includes Arthur Briggs, and Bobby Jones on trumpets; Billy Burns and Herb Fleming on trombones; Booker Pittman, clarinet and alto; Clay Sandler, alto; Roy Butler, alto, baritone; Alfred Pratt, tenor; Freddy Johnson, piano, arranger; Sterling Conaway, guitar; Juan Fernandez, bass; Billy Taylor, drums. And it was recorded in Paris, around October, 1933.
(A musical recording of the Harlemites was played at this time.)
